title: I Hope This Finds You Well
author: Natalie Sue
blurb:
Really good start but started to drag a bit. Would have been a great short novel. 
Learned I'll never insult people in white text on white background though...

title: What Kind of Paradise
author: Janelle Brown
blurb: I listened to this one and really got into it! Loved the mix of luddite/tech confrontation.

title: Presque Vierge
author: Josée Blanchette
blurb: Les putains d'hommes majeurs qui détruisent les vies de femmes mineures. Frustrant, touchant, mais surtout frustrant

title: Le mensonge du siècle, Anatomie d'une bavure médiatique et judiciaire
author: Daniel Proulx
blurb: Super intéressant d'apprendre sur le context historique et social autour de l'histoire d'Aurore 'l'enfant martyre', de l'évolution des enquêtes criminelles au québec, et des caractérisations imposées aux personnages de son entourage.

title: Meditations for Mortals
author: Oliver Burkeman
blurb: Still wondering if I'll get over it. Seriously would recommend it to anyone that is Type A, overachiever or perfectionist. I will buy the paper version and revisit it!

title: Right Thing, Right Now
author: Ryan Holiday
blurb: As good as other books from Holiday. Encouraging to do the right and virtuous things, even if it isn't easy. About living justly

title: The Woman in Me
author: Britney Spears
blurb: The woman got royally screwed by her entourage but we are all guilty to have followed the trash media laughing at her. Felt like a good dose of humility and was a light reading but informative.

title: Klara and the Sun
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
blurb: Really enjoyed it. Easy read, felt victorian-west andersony (?) in my imagination and I found it rather pleasant!

title: Advice from a Blob:
author: Lennnie
blurb: Very cute and heart-warming cartoon vignettes

title: Subculture Vulture
author: Moshe Kasher
blurb: Fascinating to learn about subcultures I didn't know much about, although I might know more about Burning Man now that I really need... Oh well.
